hypotheses.statement: Least-outstanding reduces tail TTFT versus round-robin under asynchronous mixed-length traffic.
Near saturation, SLO-risk routing improves goodput rather than merely increasing rejection rate.
With repeated prefixes, bounded affinity improves TTFT but yields to queue pressure at hotspots.
Priority-aware admission protects the online SLO while preserving an explainable batch completion rate.

claim_boundary: H1-H3 policy benefits require two independent real accelerator endpoints. A single local RTX 5070 Ti can validate mechanics only. H4 has component-level local evidence; a controlled mixed-priority load campaign remains required for a full result.
